title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 The above information shows that in almost all the States & UTs who provided the data on the subject, sufficient staff were available for administration of jail institutions. Among the various categories, Jail Staff Cadre, who are exclusively recruited for jail institutions, trained in jail management and administration are posted in all the jails. This class of staff plays a major role and formed a large percentage of the total jail staff in the various jails. The Jail Cadre staff are ably supervised and controlled by officers and supported by Correctional Staff, Medical Staff (exclusively for the jail and its inmates) and other staff. For further details, the concerned table presented at the end of this chapter may be referred.
